concerns.text: Success criteria SC-002 ('reduction in dynamic execution cycles (percentage of tasks skipped)') is specified in the spec but no task in tasks.md computes, records, or validates this metric. This drops an acceptance criterion required by the specification.

Success criteria SC-004 ('computational feasibility (runtime and memory usage) measured against GitHub Actions constraints ≤6h, ~7 GB RAM') is defined in the spec yet there is no task that measures pipeline runtime or memory consumption and validates them against the stated limits, violating the specification.
